definitions.explanation: The old province on the island of Shikoku that is now Kagawa Prefecture. The name lives on mainly in Sanuki udon.

examples.japanese: {讃岐|さぬき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{香川県|かがわけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あたる。
examples.english: Sanuki corresponds to present-day Kagawa Prefecture.

examples.japanese: {讃岐|さぬき}⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧こし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強|つよ}さ→強さ：25692_tsuyosa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Sanuki udon is known for its firm, chewy texture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空海|くうかい}→空海：31131_kuukai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{讃岐|さぬき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{伝|つた}えられている→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: Kūkai is said to have been born in the province of Sanuki.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {讃岐|さぬき}⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧: Sanuki udon, thick wheat noodles with a firm bite
- {讃岐|さぬき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧: the province of Sanuki
- {讃岐|さぬき}{富士|ふじ}: "Sanuki Fuji", a nickname for the cone-shaped Mt. Iino

CULTURAL NOTE:
Udon is so central to the region that Kagawa promotes itself as ⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ ("Udon Prefecture"). Several temples of the Shikoku pilgrimage are in former Sanuki.
